invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.
Reading, writing, normalization, diffing, reconciliation and patching preserve canonical identity, ownership, Topic context and machine-significant semantics.

semantics.breaking_rule: Diff itself does not decide compatibility; compatibility policy consumes the semantic diff.
semantics.evidence_rule: Each diff item records before/after refs and exact semantic location.
semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Each semantic diff evaluation has explicit identity. [2] Comparison aligns nodes by canonical identity.
semantics.impact_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Ownership/authority/breaking/dependency impact is explicit. [2] Diff may report impacted consumers/Topics/owners through reverse trace.
semantics.noise_rule: Whitespace, object-key order and other declared representation-only differences do not produce semantic diffs.
semantics.normalization_rule: Inputs are semantically normalized before comparison.
semantics.presentation_rule: Pure prose/layout/order changes may be distinguished from semantic changes.
semantics.semantic_rule: Diff compares machine-significant identities/ownership/relations/behavior/constraints/refs, not whitespace/key order.
